findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe JSON deserialization without limits
 * @description JSON loading without size or depth limits could lead to denial of service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-json-load
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 *        external/cwe/cwe-400
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "JSON deserialization without explicit size or depth limits could lead to DoS."
findings.hypothesis: Check for potentially unsafe JSON deserialization that could lead to denial of service through deeply nested structures or excessive memory consumption

message.text: JSON deserialization without explicit size or depth limits could lead to DoS.
